model_output.rationale: 835 shows CO-16 on all three lines with claim-level MOA N286 (missing/invalid referring provider). The 837P lists billing, rendering, subscriber, and payer parties but no referring/ordering provider loop. Therapy codes (97110, 97116) on Medicare Part B require an ordering/referring NPI. Filing indicator MB confirms Medicare Part B FFS. Fix is to add the referring provider and resubmit as a new original — Part B does not accept frequency 7.

root_cause.explanation: 837P contains no referring/ordering provider. Medicare Part B requires it for therapy services (97110, 97116). MOA N286 confirms: missing/invalid referring provider primary identifier.

next_action.detail: Add the ordering physician's NPI (verify active in PECOS and eligible to order/refer). Resubmit as new original CLM05-3 = 1 to Novitas. Do not use frequency 7 — not accepted on Part B.
